Coram : JASTI CHELAMESWAR*, C. NAGAPPAN
A B Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 - s. 319 - Power c under - Exercise of - Summoning of prosecution witness as an additional accused u/s. 319 - On facts, murder of 'V' - Trial of seven persons including appellant - Evidence of PW 64 as to the genesis of the conspiracy to kill 'V' of and also PW64 were parties at different D points of time; and that he developed cold feet after the initial stage and withdrew from the conspiracy and did not participate in the actual killing of 'V' - Thereafter, appellant filed petition uls. 319 seeking to summon PW64 as an E additional accused
Decision Date : 16-03-2015 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 454/2015 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
